visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a tan sleeveless vest top and carrying a small brown shoulder bag, stands on a sunny street in Bangkok. Behind her is a yellow two-story building with white-framed windows and a green shop awning with Thai text. (2) A young man in a green and white camouflage-patterned shirt enters the frame from the right, raising his arms in an excited greeting; they stand together in front of the yellow building as cars pass by in the background. (3) A close-up shot shows two white plastic foam containers of mango sticky rice on a dark wooden table, featuring bright yellow mango slices and white glutinous rice. (4) Inside a restaurant with gray walls and Thai signage, the man and woman sit at a wooden table, using spoons to sample the food while nodding with satisfaction at the camera. (5) The camera captures the exterior of 'Krua Apsorn,' displaying a glass door covered in eight red circular Michelin recommendation stickers from consecutive years. (6) Inside, they sit at a table; a close-up reveals a bowl of orange Tom Yum Goong soup with large visible shrimps, mushrooms, and green leafy herbs. (7) A rounded golden-brown crab omelette is shown on a white plate; the hosts use forks to break it apart, exposing the white crab meat inside, and then proceed to eat. (8) Close-up shots feature a plate of stir-fried crab meat with yellow curry and a separate plate of bright green vegetables with small shrimps. (9) Outside by a chain-link fence, the woman gestures toward a street vendor who is grilling bread rolls over a charcoal fire using metal tongs and a manual fan. (10) The woman holds a plastic bag containing a brown beverage with an exceptionally long pink straw that extends high above her head; the man kneels beside her, laughing and pointing at the straw. (11) They stand together eating grilled bread rolls filled with vibrant green pandan custard, smiling widely and gesturing toward the food as the scene concludes.
